Bug_Title: Virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code
Bug_Explanation: Virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code because it can cause the OS thread to be blocked, which can impact the scalability of the application. Therefore, virtual threads should not execute code that contains synchronized blocks or invokes synchronized methods. Platform threads should be used in these cases.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the method'showBug' and'showBug2' from the 'VirtualThreadBug' class. Both methods contain virtual threads that run tasks that include synchronized code. This triggers the bug because virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code.
